reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraph, so no invalid or directionally wrong edit is proposed.

The cited text (§ 12.3) affirmatively supports the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer): it preserves Customer's freedom to hire 'any person who responds to general recruitment' and records that Customer has made 'no ... no-hire commitment'.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months; general-solicitation carve-out) are explained correctly — there is no restricted period or prohibition to measure, so the regex misses are phrasing/absence artefacts rather than defects.
The rationale appropriately declines to double-flag § 12.4's post-term non-compete, which is an exclusivity/competition restriction rather than a personnel non-solicit and is routed to another rule.
